title: Let My Prayer Rise Like Incense

request.style: English, Byzantine Orthodox chant, deep male choir holding a sustained ison drone, solo cantor singing long melismatic ornamented lines above it, no instruments, incense-filled cathedral reverb, Byzantine modal scale, solemn and timeless, 56 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lord, I call to you, hurry to me
Listen to my voice when I call to you
Hear me, O Lord
Hear me, O Lord

[Chorus]
Let my prayer rise before you like incense
The lifting of my hands like the evening sacrifice

[Verse]
Set a guard, O Lord, over my mouth
Keep watch at the door of my lips
Hear me, O Lord
Hear me, O Lord

[Chorus]
Let my prayer rise before you like incense
The lifting of my hands like the evening sacrifice

[Outro]
Lord, have mercy
Lord, have mercy
